subject: Status: latency table doesn't transfer 1:1, accuracy does
body:
Status.

Latency validation: on current device-lab hardware the sparse models are consistently faster than dense equivalents, but the published SD835 table doesn't transfer linearly — on newer SoCs the sparse MobileNetV2 1.15 (85% sparsity) shows a smaller relative win because dense baselines got better silicon support. We'll publish our own table rather than quoting the paper's.

Accuracy repro is clean: mbv1 at width 1.0 and 90% sparsity lands at 68.4% top-1 as documented. Conversion pipeline: Freya's recipe reproduces the block-sparse structure (block size 2 from inverted-residual block 11 onward for V2), and Paloma's tooling now converts a customer model end-to-end.

Risk: the annotation UI is a week behind — rater-queue auth took longer than scoped — which squeezes the July rating round to two weeks. Recommend holding scope: pairs-only rating, no free-text.

Nikhil
